clips.title: The story
paras: Venomweb Vale is a shadowed valley in eastern Tirisfal Glades, sitting just south of the Scarlet Monastery. Once a lush woodland teeming with game, the vale has devolved into a blighted nest overrun by aggressive, venomous arachnids. Unknown to most who pass through, it also holds an ancient legacy as the sacred meeting place of the Council of Tirisfal.

Before the plague consumed Lordaeron, this valley was a peaceful retreat of lush grass and verdant trees, favored by local hunters tracking deer and rabbits. Today, rot and creeping gloom dominate the landscape. Giant, venomous spiders swarm among the trees and hollows, led by the monstrous arachnid Sri'skulk. The vale's northern edge borders the territory of the Scarlet Crusade, where darkhounds prowl near the fortified Scarlet Encampment under Lieutenant Sanders.
